rows.Kwic: 斬葛藤而誅棘莽，游智刃以無前；抉羅網而破波濤，示慧燈之普照。

Override.AttributionNote: 季總徹禪師語錄, preface by Zhang Zhu. Zhang Zhu is the exact author: the section is headed 張銖敘 and closes with his signed colophon, while the stored line says Jizong Che cut entangling vines and thorny growth with the wisdom blade.
